column4: a conflict resolution "to what the compiler accepts" can graft an int early exit (return count) into a function that now returns a packed long (runs << 32 | removed): the int widens silently and lands in the low half; after a superset merge, grep packed-return functions for bare returns of a narrower value
column5: b361ddbf0552 merged 584cf8a6d0b5 maskStatistics with the removalRuns early exit of ff0b94fc2a3b; runs field 0 -> every 512+ mask took compactRuns

column4: restoring a statistic that was broken for weeks can regress what the accidental path served well: measure the restore alone (statonly) against master before adding it; here the complete statistic sent sparse masks from compactRuns to compactWords, 15-32% slower on both CPU sets, so the compactRuns threshold moved length >>> 7 -> >>> 4

on a hybrid CPU (i9-14900HX, 8 P + 16 E cores) unpinned or tiered timing forks are bimodal (up to 2.5x) and the core types rank code paths differently (small overlapping Object[] arraycopy ~3x costlier on loaded P-cores): pin every fork from start (cmd start /affinity HEX), -XX:-TieredCompilation -Xbatch, interleave variants per sample, and decide dispatch on both a P and an E set
column5: unpinned: sparse/4096 compactRuns 5.5 vs 15.4 us between forks; pinned: 3 forks within ~10%; P sparse scalar 2x faster than runs, E 2.5x slower

column4: judge a timing regression only on cells where the two variants execute different paths; cells running identical code spread up to 1.5x net on small P-core cells (JIT profile and code layout of the other cells) and are reported as the noise floor, never as a verdict
column5: noise_max(unaffected) 1.30-1.53 on length-64 cells; affected-cell verdicts stable over t2 and t3 runs

column4: a retained NEC variant's dispatch bound is part of the idea, not of its method: pr1908 verbatim (1024+) passed its own rule but left compactScalar at 512-1023, where E-core cluster12 stayed 1.11 x master; dropping the bound (method verbatim, declared) passed both the idea and the fix rule
column5: rule THRESHOLD E/cluster12/512=1.111; rule FIX fixed regressions>5%=0
